name: Komodo Dragon

review.observation: Full original: heavy scaled monitor-like body, loose throat/neck folds, long forked pale-yellow tongue, muscular tapering tail and four visible clawed feet. Far upper limbs partly occluded; body support is elevated and requires grounded rig inspection. Tail/body ratio is approximately half total but not measured. Broad margins.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.

policyStatus: AUDIT_ONLY_CANDIDATE: production reviewed-presence.mjs still admits tail absence only.
